description: This file is a shell script that performs performance testing on a Git repository, specifically measuring the effects of different fsync configurations during operations like adding, stashing, unpacking, and committing files. It sets up test repositories, executes various Git commands under different settings, and reports performance metrics.

methods.name: populate_files
methods.description: Creates a specified number of unique files in the test repository.

methods.name: setup_repo
methods.description: Initializes a new Git repository, makes an initial commit, and populates it with unique files.

methods.name: test_perf_fsync_cfgs
methods.description: Runs performance tests with different core.fsync configuration settings.
